title: Defender for Cloud: secure score, recommendations and what to act on first

videos.script: Turn on Defender for Cloud and it hands you a list. Dozens of recommendations, each one correct. {{list}} Nobody fixes dozens at once. The skill is the order. {{order}} This lesson explains what the secure score counts, what the paid plans add, and how the shop decides what to fix first: by what an attacker could actually reach. {{reach}} Defender only exists inside a subscription, so everything here is from Microsoft's documentation, and the arithmetic is yours. {{end}}
